description:
Change products, collections, pages, articles, blogs and their metafields in a Fudge draft with sparse patches, many items in one call.
- Name only the fields you change; nested objects such as seo merge per key.
- Rows with an "id" (variants, options, media) merge by id; omit "id" to add a row; {"id": …, "_delete": true} removes one. Variants and media live at .entities/product/{id}/variants.jsonc and media.jsonc.
- Lists such as tags take a full array or {"add": […], "remove": […]}.
- Metafields: .entities/product/{id}.metafields with {"namespace.key": {"type": …, "value": …}}; "value": null removes one.
Changes to existing items are staged for the merchant’s review. Items the draft created change in Shopify at once.

file.description: An .entities doc or patch-facet path, e.g. ".entities/product/123", ".entities/product/123/variants.jsonc", or ".entities/product/123.metafields"

patch.description: Sparse JSON object using the document’s field names and value shapes. Arbitrary keys and nested JSON values are allowed; omitted fields stay unchanged.

store.description: The connected store to use. Omit when only one is connected.
